cultural.vision_reason: Hand-spun, hand-woven cotton blouse with dense wool embroidery in diamond lattice and stripe patterns on sleeves — a classic Romanian/Csángó peasant blouse form, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: blouse
physical.summary: A woman's blouse; long sleeves.  Made of undyed cream-coloured tabby woven cotton cloth; hand spun and hand woven.  Three full weaving widths [46cms wide] have been used.  Gathered neckline with maroon blanket stitch embroidery.  The upper sleeve has a rectangle of solid embroidery, a diamond lattice pattern outlined in black wool, with pink, green, yellow and blue wool yarns and small white glass (?) beads.   Below this is a band of coloured embroidery with diamond patterning.  The outer part of the sleeve has solid raised embroidery, worked on the diagonal, using the same coloured wool yarns as before.  The small cuff has a line of embroidered coloured diamonds amid a black ground and is fastened with two (non-identical) white plastic buttons.  There are symmetrical vertical lines of embroidery either side of the centre front seams, of four different widths.  The back has fewer lines of embroidery.  The original drawstring is missing.
